name_tpi: Kumu koko i blak (Sik Blak Pot)
symptoms: Brown or black spots on the pod that spread fast. Pod turns fully black, feels hard, and beans inside rot. Worst in wet season.
symptoms_tpi: Kumu i gat braun o blak spot, na em i kamap blak olgeta kwiktaim. Insait i bagarap. Em i kamap moa long taim bilong ren.
cause_en: A water mould (fungus-like) that spreads by rain splash and wet conditions.
cause_tpi: Sik i kam long wara na ren. Ren i karim sik i go long narapela kumu.
treatment_en: Remove and bury or burn all black pods. Do not leave them on the ground. Harvest ripe pods every week.
treatment_tpi: Rausim olgeta kumu i blak na planim long graun o kukim long paia. Noken larim i stap long graun. Katim mau kumu olgeta wik.
organic_treatment_en: Wood ash or lime dust on trunk base. Improve airflow by pruning shade trees.
organic_treatment_tpi: Putim sitrong paia (ash) o kambang long as bilong diwai. Katim ol han bilong diwai bilong win i ken go insait.
chemical_treatment_en: Copper fungicide (copper oxychloride / Ridomil) sprayed on pods during wet season.
chemical_treatment_tpi: Spretim kopa (copper oxychloride) long ol kumu long taim bilong ren.
prevention_en: Prune for airflow, harvest weekly, remove mummified pods, keep drains open so water does not sit.
prevention_tpi: Katim han bilong diwai, katim kumu olgeta wik, rausim drai kumu i stap long diwai, na wokim dren bilong wara i ran.

name_tpi: Kumu i gat wait paura (Sik Frosti Pot)
symptoms: Pod gets a white dusty coating like frost or flour. Inside beans are rotten. Pod may swell or deform.
symptoms_tpi: Kumu i gat wait paura antap olsem plaua. Insait i bagarap. Sampela kumu i solap o senis porm.
cause_en: Fungus spread by white spore dust carried by wind, rain, tools and hands.
cause_tpi: Sik i kam long wait paura we win o ren o han i karim i go.
treatment_en: Cut off infected pods with a knife, put straight into a bag (do not shake the dust), bury deep or burn.
treatment_tpi: Katim sik kumu na putim stret long plastic bag — noken seksekim paura. Planim dip o kukim long paia.
organic_treatment_en: Strict sanitation: remove all sick pods weekly. No effective organic spray exists.
organic_treatment_tpi: Rausim olgeta sik kumu olgeta wik. I no gat moa marasin bilong graun — klinim gaden tasol.
chemical_treatment_en: Copper-based fungicides give partial control; sanitation is the main defence.
chemical_treatment_tpi: Kopa spret i helpim liklik; klinim gaden em i namba wan.
prevention_en: Weekly harvest and removal of any suspect pods. Quarantine: do not move pods between gardens.
prevention_tpi: Katim kumu olgeta wik na rausim ol kumu yu no save. Noken karim kumu i go long narapela gaden.

symptoms: Small holes in pod surface. Inside, tunnels through the flesh and beans stick together in a hard mass. Pods ripen unevenly, yellow patches early.
symptoms_tpi: Liklik hul long pes bilong kumu. Insait i gat rot bilong binatang na ol bin i pas wantaim. Kumu i yelo haphap nating.
cause_en: A tiny moth lays eggs on the pod; larvae tunnel inside where sprays cannot reach.
cause_tpi: Liklik plang i putim egg long kumu; pikinin i go insait we spret i no inap kamap.
treatment_en: Harvest and break all pods; solarise bagged pods in sun for 2 weeks to kill larvae. Remove all pods from trees in off-season (rampasan).
treatment_tpi: Katim na brukim olgeta kumu; putim long plastic bag long san 2 wik bilong kilim binatang. Rausim olgeta kumu long taim gaden i silip.
organic_treatment_en: Sleeve young pods with plastic bags. Encourage black ants (Oecophylla) which attack the moth.
organic_treatment_tpi: Pasim yang kumu long plastic bag. Larim blak anis i stap — em i faitim plang.
chemical_treatment_en: Insecticides mostly fail because larvae live inside; focus on pod sleeving and sanitation.
chemical_treatment_tpi: Spret i no strong — binatang i hait insait. Pasim kumu na klinim gaden tasol.
prevention_en: Sleeve pods, keep a pod-free period each year, destroy infested pods far from the block.
prevention_tpi: Pasim ol kumu, givim diwai taim i no gat kumu, na bagarapim sik kumu longwe long gaden.

symptoms: Leaves yellow with green patches, then fall leaving bare branches. Branch dies back from the tip. Cut stem shows brown streaks inside.
symptoms_tpi: Lif i yelo wantaim grin spot, bihain i pundaun na han i stap nating. Han i drai stat long antap. Katim stik — insait i braun lain.
cause_en: Fungus infects through fresh leaf scars and grows inside the stem.
cause_tpi: Sik i go insait long mak we lif i bruk, na i kamap insait long stik.
treatment_en: Prune 30 cm below visible dieback, burn prunings. Paint cut with fungicide paste.
treatment_tpi: Katim 30 sentimita daunbilo long drai hap, kukim ol han. Putim marasin long hap yu katim.
organic_treatment_en: Select tolerant hybrids (e.g. VSD-tolerant clones). Maintain tree health with compost and shade balance.
organic_treatment_tpi: Planim koko kain i strong long VSD. Putim compost na holim gutpela tuda kain.
chemical_treatment_en: No reliable curative spray; protect pruning wounds.
chemical_treatment_tpi: I no gat spret i ken oraitim; lukautim hap yu katim.
prevention_en: Use tolerant planting material, avoid stressing trees, prune in dry weather.
prevention_tpi: Usim strong kain koko, noken bagarapim diwai, katim han long taim drai.

name_tpi: Lif bilong kofi i braun ananit (Sik Rust)
symptoms: Yellow-orange powdery spots on underside of leaves. Leaves drop early, branches become bare, berries shrink.
symptoms_tpi: Yelo-oren paura spot ananit long lif. Lif i pundaun kwik, han i stap nating, kofi i liklik.
cause_en: Fungus spread by wind-blown spores, worst in warm wet weather and over-shaded blocks.
cause_tpi: Sik i kam long win na ren. I bagarapim moa long gaden i gat tumas tudak.
treatment_en: Spray copper fungicide (copper oxychloride) at first sign, repeat monthly in wet season. Prune to open canopy.
treatment_tpi: Spretim kopa kwiktain yu lukim, na gen olgeta mun long taim bilong ren. Katim han bilong win i go insait.
organic_treatment_en: Copper is permitted in organic systems (within limits). Also lime-sulphur. Improve airflow, avoid excess shade.
organic_treatment_tpi: Kopa i orait long organik fom. Tu: kambang-salpa. Wokim win i kamap, daunim tudak.
chemical_treatment_en: Copper oxychloride or triazole fungicides (e.g. tebuconazole) where available.
chemical_treatment_tpi: Kopa o triazole marasin (tebuconazole) sapos i gat long stua.
prevention_en: Plant rust-resistant varieties (e.g. Catimor lines), manage shade, spray preventatively before wet season.
prevention_tpi: Planim kofi kain i strong long rust, lukautim tudak, spret bipo ren i kam.

symptoms: Dark sunken spots on green berries; berries turn black, shrivel and stay stuck on branch (mummified). Heavy crop loss.
symptoms_tpi: Blak spot i daun insait long grin kofi; kofi i blak, i drai na i pas long han. Olgeta kofi i lus.
cause_en: Fungus infects green berries through small wounds and natural openings, worse in cool wet highlands.
cause_tpi: Sik i go insait long grin kofi long liklik sua. I strong long maunten taim i kol na wet.
treatment_en: Remove and destroy mummified berries. Spray copper or chlorothalonil during flowering and early berry set.
treatment_tpi: Rausim na bagarapim ol drai kofi i pas long han. Spretim kopa long taim plaua i op na kofi i stat.
organic_treatment_en: Copper sprays plus strict removal of mummies between seasons.
organic_treatment_tpi: Kopa spret na rausim olgeta drai kofi namel long sisen.
chemical_treatment_en: Chlorothalonil or copper fungicides at 3–4 week intervals through berry development.
chemical_treatment_tpi: Chlorothalonil o kopa olgeta 3-4 wik inap kofi i mau.
prevention_en: Plant resistant Arabica varieties (e.g. Batian, Ruiru 11), prune for airflow.
prevention_tpi: Planim kofi kain i strong (Batian, Ruiru 11), katim han bilong win.

symptoms: Pin-sized hole at berry tip. Inside, beetle tunnels in the bean; beans become powdery. Berries may ripen early and drop.
symptoms_tpi: Liklik hul long antap bilong kofi. Insait binatang i kaikai bin; bin i kamap paura. Kofi i mau kwik na pundaun.
cause_en: Tiny black beetle bores into berries and breeds inside the bean.
cause_tpi: Liklik blak binatang i drilim kofi na i karim pikinin insait long bin.
treatment_en: Strip-pick all remaining berries at season end and boil or solarise them. Pick up fallen berries.
treatment_tpi: Katim olgeta kofi i stap long pinis bilong sisen na boilim o putim long san long plastic. Pekim ol kofi i pundaun.
organic_treatment_en: Beauveria bassiana fungus spray if available; trap with alcohol-baited traps; release ants/parasitoid wasps where used.
organic_treatment_tpi: Spretim Beauveria sapos i gat; wokim trap wantaim liklik wiski bilong holim plang.
chemical_treatment_en: Endosulfan historically used (now banned); use targeted sprays of imidacloprid at first entry holes.
chemical_treatment_tpi: Imidacloprid spret long taim yu lukim namba wan hul (spret isi, nogut kilim ol gutpela binatang).
prevention_en: Harvest completely — never leave old berries on tree. Dry parchment properly to kill hidden larvae.
prevention_tpi: Katim olgeta kofi — noken larim olpela i stap. Draim kofi gut bilong kilim binatang i hait.

symptoms: Tunnels in stems and tubers. Tubers smell bitter and rot. Leaves may wilt; cracks in soil near plants.
symptoms_tpi: Rot bilong binatang insait long han na kaukau. Kaukau i smel pait na i bagarap. Lif i drai; graun i op klostu long diwai.
cause_en: Small ant-like beetle lays eggs in stems; larvae tunnel down to tubers.
cause_tpi: Liklik binatang olsem anis i putim egg long han; pikinin i go daun long kaukau.
treatment_en: Dig up and destroy infested tubers — do not feed bitter tubers to pigs raw. Hill soil over exposed roots.
treatment_tpi: Dikim na bagarapim sik kaukau — noken givim kaukau i pait long pik nating. Karamapim graun antap long as.
organic_treatment_en: Deep hilling to cover tubers, rotate crops, use clean vine cuttings, mulch thickly.
organic_treatment_tpi: Putim moa graun antap, senis gaden wansensi, usim klin han bilong planim, karamapim wantaim lip.
chemical_treatment_en: Imidacloprid soil drench at planting where infestation is severe.
chemical_treatment_tpi: Imidacloprid long graun long taim bilong planim sapos sik i strong tumas.
prevention_en: Plant clean cuttings, hill up early, harvest on time, destroy crop residues after harvest.
prevention_tpi: Planim klin han, karamapim graun kwik, katim long stret taim, kukim ol pipia i pinis.

name_tpi: Lif bilong taro i bagarap (Sik Taro)
symptoms: Brown-purple spots on leaves that grow fast, with yellow ring. Watery ooze on underside. Leaf dies in days; corm stays small.
symptoms_tpi: Braun-purpur spot long lif i kamap bikpela kwik wantaim yelo ring. Wara i kamap ananit. Lif i dai long 2-3 de; taro i stap liklik.
cause_en: Water mould spread by wind, rain splash and planting infected corms. Very fast in wet weather.
cause_tpi: Sik i kam long win, ren na sik taro yu planim. I ran hariap long taim bilong ren.
treatment_en: Remove and destroy infected leaves immediately; whole plant if severe. Do not plant corms from sick gardens.
treatment_tpi: Rausim na bagarapim sik kwik; sapos i strong, rausim olgeta diwai. Noken planim taro bilong sik gaden.
organic_treatment_en: Use resistant varieties (e.g. BLB-resistant lines from NARI). Wider spacing, avoid overhead watering.
organic_treatment_tpi: Planim taro kain i strong long sik (ol kain bilong NARI). Planim longwe liklik, noken tromoi wara antap long lif.
chemical_treatment_en: Metalaxyl or copper sprays protect uninfected leaves — spray before disease arrives.
chemical_treatment_tpi: Metalaxyl o kopa i lukautim lif i no sik yet — spret bipo sik i kamap.
prevention_en: Plant resistant varieties, use clean planting material, space widely, rotate gardens.
prevention_tpi: Planim strong kain taro, usim klin taro bilong planim, givim gutpela spes, senis gaden ples.

name_tpi: Binatang i kaikai taro long graun
symptoms: Holes and tunnels in corm; plant wilts and can be pulled out easily. Grubs and beetles found in soil around roots.
symptoms_tpi: Hul na rot insait long taro; diwai i drai na yu inap pulim aut isi. Ol kapul na binatang i stap long graun.
cause_en: Adult beetles burrow into corms at night; grubs also feed on roots.
cause_tpi: Bikpela binatang i digim taro long nait; pikinin i kaikai as tu.
treatment_en: Dig soil around plants and hand-pick beetles and grubs. Destroy heavily tunneled corms.
treatment_tpi: Dikim graun klostu long diwai na kisim binatang long han. Bagarapim taro i gat planti hul.
organic_treatment_en: Trap beetles with rotting banana stems or coconut husks; flood the garden if possible (beetles drown). Wood ash in planting hole deters.
organic_treatment_tpi: Wokim trap wantaim olpela han bilong banana o sel bilong kokonas; pulim wara long gaden sapos inap (binatang i dai long wara). Putim sitrong paia long hul bilong planim.
chemical_treatment_en: Chlorpyrifos soil treatment at planting in severe areas (follow label).
chemical_treatment_tpi: Chlorpyrifos long graun long taim bilong planim long ples sik i strong.
prevention_en: Rotate taro with non-root crops, plant on ridges, remove old banana stumps that breed beetles.
prevention_tpi: Senis taro wantaim kain kaikai i no as, planim antap long banis graun, rausim olpela banana stam.

name_tpi: Banana i stap liklik wantaim paspas lif (BBTV)
symptoms: New leaves narrow, upright and bunched at top like a rosette. Yellow edges. Plant stunted; fruit small or none.
symptoms_tpi: Nupela lif i liklik, i sanap na i bung wantaim antap olsem plaua. Sait bilong lif i yelo. Banana i no kamap bikpela; kaikai i liklik o i nogat.
cause_en: Virus carried by banana aphids; also spreads through infected suckers used for planting.
cause_tpi: Sik i kam long liklik laus bilong banana; tu, sik i go long nupela gaden sapos yu planim sik han.
treatment_en: No cure. Dig out and burn the whole infected stool including all suckers.
treatment_tpi: I no gat marasin. Dikim aut olgeta banana wantaim ol pikinin na kukim long paia.
organic_treatment_en: Control aphids with soapy water; only plant suckers from healthy gardens.
organic_treatment_tpi: Kilim laus wantaim sop wara; planim han bilong gaden i orait tasol.
chemical_treatment_en: No chemical cures the virus. Aphid control only slows spread.
chemical_treatment_tpi: I no gat marasin bilong virus. Spret bilong laus i helpim liklik tasol.
prevention_en: Use certified clean planting material, inspect gardens weekly, rogue sick plants fast.
prevention_tpi: Usim klin han bilong planim, luklukim gaden olgeta wik, rausim sik diwai hariap.

name_tpi: Lif bilong banana i gat blak lain
symptoms: Dark streaks on leaves that merge; leaf dries and collapses early. Bunches small, fruit may ripen in the garden.
symptoms_tpi: Blak lain long lif i bung wantaim; lif i drai na hangamap kwik. Bungs i liklik, banana i ken mau long diwai nating.
cause_en: Fungus spread by wind-borne spores; thrives in warm wet weather.
cause_tpi: Sik i kam long win; i laikim hot na wet taim.
treatment_en: Cut and remove badly streaked leaves (keep at least 10 leaves per plant). Apply mineral oil + fungicide spray if available.
treatment_tpi: Katim ol lif i gat planti blak (larim inap 10 lif long wanwan diwai). Sapos i gat, spretim mineral oel wantaim marasin.
organic_treatment_en: Weekly de-leafing of sick leaves, wide spacing, good drainage.
organic_treatment_tpi: Katim sik lif olgeta wik, planim longwe, holim dren i ran.
chemical_treatment_en: Protectant: mancozeb. Systemic: tebuconazole or propiconazole alternated to avoid resistance.
chemical_treatment_tpi: Mancozeb bilong karamap; tebuconazole o propiconazole senis-senis bilong sik i no winim marasin.
prevention_en: Space plants widely, orient rows to wind, remove diseased leaves before wet season.
prevention_tpi: Planim longwe, stretim lain long rot bilong win, rausim sik lif bipo ren.

symptoms: Ragged holes in leaves, sawdust-like droppings in the whorl. Caterpillars with pale 'Y' mark on head hide in whorl by day.
symptoms_tpi: Lif i gat hul haphap nating, pipia olsem sopda insait long hat bilong kon. Kapul i gat wait 'Y' mak long het i hait insait long de.
cause_en: Moth caterpillar that arrived recently; feeds inside the growing point of corn.
cause_tpi: Kapul bilong plang; i kaikai insait long hat bilong nupela kon.
treatment_en: Hand-pick caterpillars in the morning. Apply ash, sand or soapy water into the whorl to suffocate them.
treatment_tpi: Kisim kapul long han long moning. Putim sitrong paia, wes o sop wara insait long hat bilong killim.
organic_treatment_en: Neem seed extract or ash+lime mix in whorl. Release/keep natural enemies (wasps, birds).
organic_treatment_tpi: Wara bilong nim bin o sitrong paia wantaim kambang insait long hat. Larim pisin na liklik plang i helpim.
chemical_treatment_en: Emamectin benzoate or chlorantraniliprole sprayed into the whorl at early stage.
chemical_treatment_tpi: Emamectin o chlorantraniliprole insait long hat long taim kapul i liklik yet.
prevention_en: Plant early with the first rains, intercrop with beans, scout fields twice a week.
prevention_tpi: Planim kon wantaim namba wan ren, planim wantaim bin, luklukim gaden tupela taim long wik.

symptoms: Leaves show yellow-green mosaic patches, twisted and small. Plants stunted, tubers tiny.
symptoms_tpi: Lif i gat yelo-grin spot, i krukpuk na liklik. Diwai i no kamap; tapioka i liklik tumas.
cause_en: Virus carried by whiteflies and spread through infected cuttings.
cause_tpi: Sik i kam long wait plang na sik han yu planim.
treatment_en: Pull out and destroy stunted plants. Replant with clean cuttings from healthy plants only.
treatment_tpi: Pulimautim na bagarapim diwai i no kamap. Planim gen wantaim klin han bilong gutpela diwai tasol.
organic_treatment_en: Select resistant varieties; take cuttings only from symptom-free plants.
organic_treatment_tpi: Planim strong kain tapioka; kisim han bilong diwai i no gat mak bilong sik.
chemical_treatment_en: No chemical cure; manage whiteflies if severe.
chemical_treatment_tpi: I no gat marasin; lukautim wait plang sapos i planti tumas.
prevention_en: Use clean certified cuttings, remove sick plants early, control weeds hosting whiteflies.
prevention_tpi: Usim klin han, rausim sik diwai kwik, klinim gras we wait plang i stap.

symptoms: Reddish-brown pustules on underside of leaves that release dust when rubbed. Leaves yellow and drop; pods fill poorly.
symptoms_tpi: Braun-rek bomp ananit long lif i lusim paura taim yu rabim. Lif i yelo na pundaun; pinat i no pulap.
cause_en: Fungus spread by wind; loves humid weather and dense plantings.
cause_tpi: Sik i kam long win; i laikim wet taim na gaden i pasait tumas.
treatment_en: Spray mancozeb or copper at first sign; repeat every 2 weeks if rain continues.
treatment_tpi: Spretim mancozeb o kopa kwiktaim yu lukim; spret gen olgeta 2 wik sapos ren i gohet.
organic_treatment_en: Early planting to escape peak disease period, wider spacing, remove crop residues.
organic_treatment_tpi: Planim kwik bilong abrusim taim bilong sik, givim spes, rausim ol pipia bilong gaden.
prevention_en: Rotate with non-legume crops, plant resistant varieties, avoid late planting.
prevention_tpi: Senis wantaim kaikai i no famili bilong pinat, planim strong kain, noken planim leit.

symptoms: No disease signs detected. Leaves and fruit look normal.
symptoms_tpi: I no lukim mak bilong sik. Lif na kaikai i luk orait.
treatment_en: No treatment needed. Keep up weekly garden checks.
treatment_tpi: I nogat samting bilong wokim. Luklukim gaden olgeta wik.
organic_treatment_en: Maintain good soil with compost and mulch.
organic_treatment_tpi: Putim compost na lip long graun.
prevention_en: Keep drains open, remove weeds, watch for early disease signs.
prevention_tpi: Holim dren i ran, klinim gras, lukautim stat bilong sik.
